name: careernova-ai
description: CareerNova AI - AI Career Guidance Platform with Neon PostgreSQL

scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'), fs = require('fs'); const py = fs.existsSync('.venv/Scripts/python.exe') ? '.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe' : (fs.existsSync('.venv/bin/python') ? '.venv/bin/python' : 'python'); execSync(py + ' init_db.py', { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.test: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'), fs = require('fs'); const py = fs.existsSync('.venv/Scripts/pytest.exe') ? '.venv\\Scripts\\pytest.exe' : (fs.existsSync('.venv/bin/pytest') ? '.venv/bin/pytest' : 'pytest'); execSync(py + ' -v', { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.start: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'), fs = require('fs'); const py = fs.existsSync('.venv/Scripts/python.exe') ? '.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe' : (fs.existsSync('.venv/bin/python') ? '.venv/bin/python' : 'python'); execSync(py + ' app.py', { stdio: 'inherit' });"
